description: This Java source file defines the `ServerHitBin` class within the `org.apache.ofbiz.webapp.stats` package. It handles counting, binning, and persisting statistical data about server hits and requests such as requests, events, views, entities, and services. It manages in-memory structures for current and historical statistics, supports bin rotation based on configurable time intervals, and includes methods for incrementing counts, persisting data, and generating statistical reports.

classes.name: ServerHitBin
classes.description: A final class for counting, binning, and persisting server request statistics. It tracks hits over time, supports configurable bin durations, and persists bin data to the database as needed.
